During the Obama administration, schools were put under the threat of investigation if suspension rates were different by race.

A student was violent, or brought a weapon to school? It didn't matter. Schools were still under the threat of investigation. 

"They were really concerned about aggregate statistics and not concerned about the underlying behavior...so a lot of schools stopped reporting when things were happening. But that didn't stop the violence from happening."
